01.r: The people will cry for help under the king they wanted.
01.n: Gesenius: to cry out, especially for sorrow, as complaining and imploring aid. A perfect with 'and', carrying on the future of Samuel's warning; YLT renders the form literally, 'have cried out'.

02.r: The time when the king's burdens are felt.
02.n: Literally 'in the day'; with 'that' it means 'on that day', 'at that time'.

03.r: Points to the day of the cry.

04.r: The king himself is the cause of the cry.
04.n: Literally 'from to the face of'. STEPBible tags this occurrence with the sense 'because'. The DRC keeps the literal picture: 'from the face of the king'.

05.r: The king the people asked for.

07.r: The people chose this king themselves.
07.n: A perfect: from the standpoint of that day the choice is already made. Gesenius places a sense 'to prove, to examine' before 'to choose' for this verb; here the sense is choosing.

08.r: The king was their own choice, for their own wish.

09.r: Sets the LORD's silence against their cry.
09.n: The Hebrew is 'and not'; it is counted here with 'will not answer'. The BSB reads 'but'.

10.r: The LORD will not respond to their cry.
10.n: BDB: answer, respond. The KJV, Geneva and DRC say 'hear'; the JPS, ASV, YLT and BSB say 'answer'.

11.r: The personal name of Israel's God.
11.n: Gesenius: Jehovah, the proper name of the supreme God among the Hebrews, which later Hebrews would not pronounce. The KJV, Geneva and DRC say 'the Lord', the JPS 'HaShem', the ASV and YLT 'Jehovah', the BSB 'the LORD'.

13.r: The same day as the cry.
13.n: The verse closes with the same phrase it opened with, 'on that day'.

_extra.11: ἑν: part of 'in the days', which in the text as given stands here; likely displaced from the closing 'in those days'.
_extra.12: ταῖς: as above, likely displaced from the closing phrase.
_extra.13: ἡμέραις (days): as above, likely displaced from the closing phrase.
_extra.24: ὅτι (because): the Greek adds 'because you chose a king for yourselves'; nothing in the Hebrew answers to it. The DRC has the same addition.
_extra.25: ὑμεῖς (you): part of the Greek addition.
_extra.26: ἐξελέξασθε (you chose): part of the Greek addition.
_extra.27: ἑαυτοῖς (for yourselves): part of the Greek addition.
_extra.28: βασιλέα (a king): part of the Greek addition.

01.n: βοάω, to cry out, call aloud.

04.n: ἐκ προσώπου, 'from the face of': the Greek keeps the Hebrew picture, as the DRC does.

07.n: ξασθε is the end of ἐξελέξασθε, 'you chose for yourselves', from ἐκλέγω, to choose; the text as given has lost its start.

10.n: ἐπακούω, to hear, give ear to: closer to the KJV's 'hear' than to 'answer'.

13.n: The Greek reads 'in those days', plural, where the Hebrew has 'in that day'.
